spec.prompt: the cosmonaut Alexei Leonov (face and suit exactly as in the first two reference images) pulls himself hand over hand along the tether back to the open mouth of the Volga airlock cylinder (third reference). He tries to enter feet first, but his swollen rigid suit jams against the rim; he pushes back out, turns, struggles. Desperate, physical, the Earth wheeling below. Handheld camera close to the action. Photorealistic, shot on 35mm film, IMAX documentary realism in the spirit of Apollo 11 (2019) and Gravity. Accurate 1965 Soviet hardware: the white Berkut spacesuit with rust-orange harness straps, a white helmet with red CCCP letters above the visor, Soviet markings only. Hard directional sunlight, deep black space, crisp silhouettes. No on-screen text, no captions.
